title: Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion for Query Reformulation in Dense Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.29464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense retrieval has become a fundamental paradigm for modern information retrieval, supporting efficient semantic search across a wide range of applications. Its effectiveness, however, relies critically on query embeddings that adequately capture users' information needs, which can be difficult for short, ambiguous, or underspecified queries. Feedback-based query reformulation approaches like pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF) alleviate this by incorporating additional evidence from retrieved or generated content. However, existing embedding-space approaches commonly aggregate or interpolate feedback vectors, implicitly treating them as complete target representations. Such pointwise fusion can unnecessarily suppress query corrections along directions not expressed by individual feedback items, even when these directions are supported by complementary evidence. translated_title: 面向密集检索中查询重构的方向性后验反馈融合
translated_abstract: 密集检索已成为现代信息检索的基础范式，支撑着跨广泛应用场景的高效语义搜索。然而，其有效性关键取决于查询嵌入能否充分捕捉用户的信息需求，而对于简短、模糊或信息不完整的查询而言，这一点往往难以实现。基于反馈的查询重构方法，如伪相关性反馈（PRF），通过纳入来自检索或生成内容的额外证据来缓解这一问题。然而，现有的嵌入空间方法通常对反馈向量进行聚合或插值，隐式地将其视为完整的目标表示。这种逐点融合方式可能会不必要地抑制查询沿单个反馈项所未表达方向的修正，即使这些方向得到了互补证据的支持。为解决这一局限，我们提出了方向性后验反馈融合（Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion）方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了方向性后验反馈融合方法，通过以方向性方式融合反馈证据而非简单的逐点聚合或插值，克服了现有嵌入空间查询重构方法会抑制仅由互补证据支持的方向上查询修正的缺陷，从而提升密集检索对简短、模糊查询的处理效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion, which fuses feedback evidence directionally rather than through pointwise aggregation or interpolation, overcoming the limitation of existing embedding-space query reformulation methods that unnecessarily suppress query corrections along directions supported only by complementary evidence.
